name: Children's Protection Society Malaysia (CPSM)
summary: Protects vulnerable children through safe shelter, rehabilitation, education and family reintegration, and campaigns to prevent abuse nationwide.
programmes: Safe Child, Strong Nation national campaign (June 2026 - May 2027)
beneficiaries: Neglected, abused, abandoned and otherwise vulnerable children

organisation.founders: Dato' Seri Nazir Ariff with co-founders Datin Dr. Chandra Kanagalingam and Datin Seri Elizabeth Devaraj; began in Penang as a temporary shelter for neglected and abandoned children, launched April 1992
organisation.leadership: Tengku Amir Shah Ibni Sultan Sharafuddin Idris Shah, Raja Muda Selangor (Royal Patron); Dato' Seri Nazir Ariff (President); Suraya Ibrahim and Sharmila Kanagalingam (Vice Presidents); Magdeline Leong (Executive Director & Honorary Secretary); Rachel Rajendran (Honorary Treasurer)

live.note: Runs the 'Safe Child, Strong Nation' podcast on Spotify and YouTube (2026); YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/@ChildrensProtectionSociety

donationsToday: One-time online gift; monthly Stripe plans (RM25/50/100/custom); bank transfer (Maybank, Greenlane Branch, Penang; SWIFT available for overseas); Touch 'n Go QR. Email proof to admin@cpsm.org.my for a receipt.
